 MEAC Football Conference Play Begins Friday
 Football | 10/22/2026 4:13:11 PM
 Story Links
 NORFOLK, Va. – The Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference (MEAC) football season enters conference play this week, with all six teams in action across three matchups.
North Carolina Central visits Delaware State on Friday, Oct. 23, before Norfolk State travels to South Carolina State and Howard faces Morgan State on Saturday, Oct. 24.
 Week 8 Schedule 
Friday, Oct. 23 
North Carolina Central at Delaware State | 5:00 PM | ESPN2
 Saturday, Oct. 24 
Norfolk State at South Carolina State | 1:30 PM | ESPN+
Howard at Morgan State | 3:00 PM | ESPN+
*All Times ET
 MEAC Football Notes 
 Against Other FCS Conferences 
The MEAC has compiled a 14-12 record against other FCS conferences this season, highlighted by a 7-3 mark against the CAA and a 3-1 mark against the SWAC.
 Getting After the Quarterback 
Three MEAC programs rank in the top 20 nationally in sacks per game: South Carolina State is fifth (3.14), while Morgan State (2.86) and Norfolk State (2.43) rank seventh and 16th, respectively.
 Complimentary Football 
South Carolina State leads the country in scoring offense (43.6 points per game), while also ranking first nationally in total defense, allowing just 241.6 yards per game.
 Opportunistic Defense 
North Carolina Central and Norfolk State are tied for third nationally with 16 turnovers forced this season.
 MEAC in the Rankings 
South Carolina State climbed to No. 3 in this week’s Black College Football Poll, followed by Morgan State at No. 4 and Delaware State at No. 5.
Norfolk State also earned a top-10 ranking at No. 9, while Howard received votes.

 Around the League 
 Howard’s Homecoming Win 
 Howard rushed for 201 yards and four touchdowns to defeat Morehouse 31-17 on Saturday at Greene Stadium. Eden James led the Bison with 120 rushing yards and a touchdown on 13 carries, including a 61-yard scoring run in the third quarter. Ja’Shawn Scroggins added 42 rushing yards and two touchdowns, while Travis Kerney scored on a fourth-quarter run. Howard scored 14 unanswered points in the fourth quarter to pull away and improve to 3-4 on the season.
 About the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference 
The Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference (MEAC) enters its 56th year of intercollegiate competition with the 2026–27 academic year. Headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the MEAC is comprised of eight distinguished Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) along the Atlantic seaboard: Coppin State University, Delaware State University, Howard University, University of Maryland Eastern Shore, Morgan State University, Norfolk State University, North Carolina Central University, and South Carolina State University. Since its founding in 1970, the MEAC has been dedicated to promoting academic excellence, sportsmanship, and the personal growth of student athletes. For more information, visit www.MEACSports.com .
